finding.caveat: Wi-Fi, or other people at home using the internet heavily at those hours, can look the same.
finding.evidence: Based on 279 tests over 30 days; each evening hour was tested at least 11 times across 2 providers. Slower on 24 of 24 evenings.
finding.text: Every region slows from about 9 pm to 1 am, with every provider we could test: tests read about 40% below the same servers' usual results. That points to your internet provider's own network.
